name: Four Seasons Hotel Alexandria
positioning: Mediterranean luxury hotel on Alexandria's Corniche, with a beach across the road
best_for: Couples and families wanting a city stay with beach time in summer
Guests who like several dining venues on site

facts.text: Located at 399 El Geish Road, Alexandria, on the Corniche, with a 180-degree Mediterranean view.
170 accommodations in total: 87 guest rooms, 31 suites, 30 beach suites and 22 villas with private pool, plus The Palace.
Interiors are by Pierre Yves Rochon and the architecture is by WZMH.
Dining includes Stefano's (Southern Italian), Kala (international), Fresca Bistro and Lounge (Mediterranean) and Byblos (Lebanese), plus a seasonal Beach Restaurant.
Lounges include Bleu, Le Bar, the Lobby Lounge and the Arabesque shisha lounge.
The spa has 13 treatment rooms in a contemporary European style, with signature treatments including the 1,001 Nights Sensation (140 minutes).
Three pools: a circular infinity pool on the fourth floor, a heated indoor pool on the fifth floor, and a sea-water beach infinity pool with cabanas.

highlights.text: A sandy beach with landscaping sits across the street from the hotel and is reached safely by a tunnel under the road.
The beach has a sea-water infinity pool with cabanas.
The hotel has five restaurants, from Southern Italian at Stefano's to Lebanese at Byblos.
22 villas with private pool, plus The Palace, are available for guests who want more privacy.

considerations.text: The hotel is about 60 kilometres (37 miles), or around 60 minutes, from Borg El Arab Airport.
The beach is across the street from the hotel, reached by a tunnel under the road, so it is not directly outside the main building.
The Beach Restaurant and Lounge operates in summer only.
Cairo is 225 kilometres (140 miles) from the hotel, so a Pyramids visit means a long day trip.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily (the standard published rate is room only, with breakfast usually extra).
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers are combinable with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access (the standard published rate charges extra for internet access).
